name: Minds 8: the watcher advantage against the share of watchers
description: The watcher advantage at the end of the first winter (watcher_advantage: watchers alive ÷ watcher founders − non-watchers alive ÷ non-watcher founders, the dead counting as 0; window_mean, ticks 190–200) in watch-scroungers' world (theft-winter's winter, no stumbling on caches, every agent burying half its surplus where it stands, no cheaters) against the share of agents that watch (watching.watchers): 0.1, 0.2, …, 0.9, dealt by id. Producer–scrounger theory predicts the advantage falls as watchers grow common (negative frequency dependence). Seeds 1–20.
